Question: Salam, I like to know if you thread/pluk n keep ur self mentained (not simple) is allowed for sake of ur huzband. as i've heard doing such thingz creat menly fitna' but if huzband allowz this for hiz wife iz it permisable (allowed) in islam? Hoping 2 hear from u soon, JazakAllah, Answer ID: 6131 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 994/983=D/1429) Plucking hair only for beauty is unlawful though with the permission of husband and his pleasure. The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) cursed the women who pluck the hair and who get their hair plucked. (Mishkwat) If there is excess hair on face abnormally which cause ugliness then it is allowed to set it, according to the scholars of Fiqh. A woman can have makeup and beautification within Shariah limits; rather it is a matter of reward if done for seeking the pleasure of husband. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
